headline: Indian IT services posted mixed revenue growth with AI driving upside for several firms.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from low single digits to over 50% YoY. AI‑related revenue rose sharply at Infosys, LTM, Mphasis and HCLTech, supporting profit expansion. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys but raised at Coforge and Mphasis. Profit margins improved at most firms, though Wipro saw a slight decline.

themes.title: AI‑led revenue acceleration
themes.detail: AI revenue grew double‑digit percentages at Infosys (29%), LTM (47%) and HCLTech ($219 m), boosting profits.

themes.title: Guidance divergence
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2%, while Coforge and Mphasis raised their outlooks.

themes.title: Margin pressure at mid‑tier players
themes.detail: Operating margins slipped at LTM (15.6%) and Wipro (16.5%) despite revenue growth.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Revenue grew 21.2% YoY, the highest among large caps.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 9.1% YoY and net profit fell 1.9%.
Revenue grew only 3% YoY and margin was unusually high, indicating limited growth scope.
